title: C482/524/2015 of Ram Kishore Arya Vs Subhash Chandra Agarwal AND ANOTHER

paras.text:
C-482 No. 524 of 2015
Honíble Sudhanshu Dhulia, J.
 Mr. Arvind Vashistha, Senior
Advocate, assisted by Mr. Vivek Pathak,
Advocate, present for the applicant.
 Mr. B.M. Pingal, learned Brief
Holder, present for the State.
 The applicant has been convicted
under Section 420 of I.P.C. and
sentenced for five years simple
imprisonment with a fine of Rs.5,000.00
(Rupees five thousand only). In default,
he has to undergo further three months
imprisonment.
 In his appeal, the applicant
wanted to file additional evidence, by
filing an application under Section 391
of Cr.P.C., on which certain order has
been passed by the learned lower
appellate court vide order dated
23.04.2015 holding that such an
evidence will be considered at the time
of final judgment.
 This order has been challenged by
the applicant before this Court by
means of the present application under
Section 482 Cr.P.C.
 On 19.05.2015, after arguing in
detail, the learned counsel for the
applicant had sought permission for
adjournment.
 Today, the learned counsel for the
applicant says that he wants to
withdraw this application.
 In view thereof, the application
under Section 482 Cr.P.C. is hereby
dismissed as withdrawn.
 (Sudhanshu Dhulia, J.)
 20.05.2015
Ankit
